_comment: DESIGN v3 section 7.3 expression harmonisation. DRAFT - the PI freezes it (with configs/harmonisation_frozen.json at tag freeze-transfer). Read by scripts/harmonise_expression.py and essml.expr_harmonise. 'selection_rule' was written BEFORE the candidate comparison was run; 'chosen_method' is filled from that rule's outcome and the script fails if they disagree. No screen data and no prediction model are used anywhere in this step.

depmap_convention.tpm_over: all genes (TPM sums to 1e6 over every annotated gene, spike-ins removed), then subset to DepMap protein-coding Entrez columns; per-line protein-coding TPM sums are ~0.94M in DepMap (median of all 26Q3 lines 938k)

annotation.gene_length: exon-union length per gene_id (all transcripts' exons merged), Ensembl 116

conversion._counts_fragment_length_comment: effective length = exon-union length - fragment_length + 1 (genes with effective length <= 0 get TPM 0, as RSEM). 0 means plain exon-union length. Checked against ENCODE RSEM TPM from the same files' expected_count (results/expression_harmonisation/count_path_check.csv); the value is not tuned on the method-comparison metrics.
conversion._restricted_comment: sources whose table does not cover all genes (pre-filtered) cannot give TPM over all genes; their TPM is rescaled so the protein-coding subset sums to the DepMap dev median protein-coding TPM sum (closest compliant option; flagged in profiles.csv)

encode_geo.unit: TPM (RSEM, GENCODE v24; ERCC spike-ins removed, renormalised)
encode_geo.label: ENCODE polyA RNA-seq (ENCODE-DCC GEO deposit)

mair2019.unit: HTSeq counts (GENCODE v25) -> TPM via Ensembl 116 lengths
mair2019.label: Mair 2019 GSE125509 H1-iCas9

yilmaz2018.label: Yilmaz 2018 GSE103846 (H9 Rex1-EGFP hESC per GEO)

tian2019_quantseq.unit: Quant-seq 3' tag counts -> CPM (no length correction)
tian2019_quantseq.label: Tian 2019 GSE124703 Quant-seq

drager2022.unit: per-sample values summing to 1e6 over 60,232 genes (TPM assumed; checked by length dependence)
drager2022.label: Draeger 2022 Supp. Table 1

carnevale2022.unit: Kallisto gene counts (symbols; genes zero in >80% samples removed) -> TPM
carnevale2022.label: Carnevale 2022 GSE204862

calderon2019.unit: normalised gene abundance (20,206 Ensembl genes) treated as counts -> TPM
calderon2019.label: Calderon 2019 GSE118165

sack2018.unit: per-sample NormCounts (genes with <20 reads across samples removed) -> TPM
sack2018.label: Sack 2018 GSE109326 HMEC

evaluation.hvg_definition: top-5000 genes by variance of log2(TPM+1) across DepMap dev lines
evaluation.nn_pool: all DepMap dev lines (configs/splits.csv role == dev); a test-line validation profile's pool is dev lines plus that test line
evaluation.correlation: Pearson across HVG (primary, uncentred as DESIGN 7.3 states); gene-centred (minus DepMap dev mean) reported as sensitivity
evaluation.ad_definition: mean (1 - Pearson r) over the 10 nearest DepMap dev lines on HVG in the harmonised space; reference = the same statistic for each dev line against the other dev lines
evaluation.fitting_holdout: candidate (iii) offsets: leave-one-matched-line-out (primary) and leave-one-source-out (sensitivity); quantile reference excludes the matched line's own DepMap profile

candidates.quantile: per-profile quantile normalisation to the mean sorted DepMap dev log2(TPM+1) profile (ties averaged; profiles with missing genes interpolated)
candidates.quantile_location: quantile + gene-wise mean offset (DepMap - external) fitted on matched DepMap dev lines
candidates.rank: within-profile rank / n for both external and DepMap (would require retraining E features on ranks)
candidates.celligner: DEFERRED per DESIGN v3 (needs tumour data / cPCA+MNN; not implemented)

selection_rule.population: exact-match DepMap dev validation profiles (near-matches and test lines reported separately, never used for selection)
selection_rule.primary: mean same-line recall@1 among all DepMap dev lines (HVG Pearson, held-out for fitted candidates)
selection_rule.secondary: mean held-out profile Pearson r with the line's DepMap profile across all genes, then mean absolute error
selection_rule.rule: take the best primary; any candidate within tie_margin of it is a tie; among ties prefer the better secondary if it is better by > 0.01 r, else the simplest in simplicity_order. candidate (iii) must also not lose more than tie_margin recall@1 under leave-one-source-out, else it is excluded. 'rank' requires retraining E on ranks; if chosen it is flagged for the PI.
